newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST-China savings seen up 29 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-China savings seen up 29 pct in 1997.

text.p: China's individual savings rate was expected to rise by 29 percent to 4,971 billion yuan in 1997, said a report by a group of economists from the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences and the State Statistics Bureau.
Earlier reports said China expected personal savings to increase to 4,700 billion yuan at the end of 1997, from 3,850 billion yuan at end-1996 -- an increase of 29.9 percent
Officials have said the expected the personal savings rate to slow in 1997 because of lower interest rates and competition for funds from other financial instruments.
